Focusing on the central theme of how one can alleviate the suffering of deceased relatives reborn in the realm of ghosts, the text is represented by five translations across five languages indexed on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral]. Identical stock verses (§§11–14) are also shared with multiple poems in the *Vimānavatthu*, such as the *Guttilavimānavatthu* (Vv 33), *Lakhumāvimānavatthu* (Vv 19), and *Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavatthu* (Vv 14) [DharmaNexus].
